title: Crypto-Cash Back: Tax Reporting for Cryptocurrency Rewards
summary: This document explains tax reporting for cryptocurrency rewards when crypto redemptions occur. It instructs users to download annual statements and any provided tax forms, check the app’s Documents/Tax section after year-end, and keep records of redemption dates, amounts, and assets received (and export transaction history if needed).
